records.jp: 「私、リフレクターになる！」^00　陽桜莉の言葉を聞いたとき、瑠夏は彼女がひどく眩しく遠い存在に見えた。^00　想いを力に戦うリフレクター。少女たちの想いを狙う謎の存在。田辺百から^00聞かされた話はまるで、ゲームやアニメの世界のことのようで、そう簡単に信^00じられるわけがない。^00　……それに、もし仮に信じられたとしても、きっと私はリフレクターになる^00資格なんてない。^00　瑠夏の葛藤をよそに、陽桜莉はリフレクターになることを決めた。リフレク^00ターについて、百から聞かされた以上の情報は知らない。もしかしたら命懸け^00の戦いになるかもしれない。普通の女子高生じゃいられないかもしれない。だ^00というのに、「困っている人を放っておきたくないから」と。ただそれだけの^00理由で、彼女は百の誘いを受けたのだ。^00　困っている人を見つけたら、迷うことなく手を差し伸べる。彼女の純粋な信^00念が瑠夏には羨ましかった。「私は必要じゃないかもしれない」「私じゃ助け^00にならないかもしれない」と、逡巡して踏み出せなかった一歩を、平原陽桜莉^00という少女は踏み出せる。^00　……私も、変わりたい。^00　そんな想いの灯が、いつしか瑠夏の心の奥を仄かに照らし始めていた。
records.en_original: "I'm going to become a Reflector!"^00^00Hiori Hirahara had seemed so dazzling and distant to Ruka when she said those words.^00^00Reflectors fighting using the power of their feelings. Mysterious beings preying on girls' emotions. The stories Momo Tanabe had told them sounded like something straight out of a game or anime—far too fantastical to believe so easily.^00^00(...Even if I could believe it, I'm sure I don't have what it takes to become a Reflector.)^00^00While Ruka struggled with her doubts, Hiori Hirahara had already made up her mind. She didn't know any more about Reflectors than what Momo had told them. It might turn out to be a life-or-death battle. She might never get to be just an ordinary high school girl again. And yet, for no reason other than, "I can't just ignore someone who's in trouble," she had accepted Momo's invitation.^00^00If Hiori found someone in need, she would help them without hesitation. Ruka envied that pure-hearted conviction. Thoughts like, "Maybe I'm not needed," or "Maybe I won't be any help," always held Ruka back. But Hiori Hirahara was someone who could take that first step forward without wavering.^00^00(...I want to change, too.)^00^00Before she knew it, the light from that wish began to softly illuminate the depths of Ruka's heart.

records.jp: 「大丈夫かしら、あの二人……」^00　物陰から陽桜莉と瑠夏の二人を撮影しながら、都は呟いた。背後を通る生徒^00たちからの変人を見るような視線を感じるが、これは断じて隠し撮りなどでは^00ない。そう、これは見守り撮りなのだと、そう自分に言い聞かせ、都は意識を^00二人に戻した。今は好きな曲のジャンルについて話しているようだが、二人の^00好みは絶妙に反対を向いているようだった。^00「まずはその、圧倒的なコミュニケーション不足をどうにかしなさい！」^00　そう言って陽桜莉と瑠夏の二人にもっと互いのことを知る努力をするように^00焚きつけたのは都だ。だからこそ、陽桜莉たちの頑張りを最後まで見届ける義^00務があると意気込んでいるのだ。とはいえ、しばらく二人を観察してみて分か^00ったことが一つ。あの二人にはあまりにも共通点が無さすぎる。好きな食べ物^00から洗濯の干し方に至るまで、まるでバラバラ。そんな共通点の無さを記録し^00続けた彼女は、ついに冒頭の台詞に至ったのである。^00　頑張って、二人とも。^00　自分を救ってくれたのはあの二人。そして、自分のために生きていきたいと^00思わせてくれたのもあの二人だ。だから、リフレクターとして共に戦うことは^00できない代わりに、見守って、応援して、彼女たちの力になりたい。^00　そんな秘密の想いを胸に、都は今日も陽桜莉と瑠夏にカメラを向け続ける。
records.en_original: "Are those two really going to be all right?" Miyako muttered to herself as she filmed Hiori and Ruka from the shadows. She could feel the judging stares of other students as they passed behind her, but this was absolutely not secret filming. Yes, she told herself, this was just keeping a watchful eye on them. Miyako concentrated on the two once again. They seemed to be talking about their favorite music genres, but their tastes were perfectly mismatched.^00^00"First of all, you two really need to do something about your lack of communication!"^00^00Miyako had told Hiori and Ruka that to spur them to get to know each other better. That's why she felt it was her duty to see their effort through to the end. Still, after watching the two of them for a while, she realized one thing: they had almost nothing in common. From favorite foods to how they hang up their laundry, they couldn't have been more different. Thus, as she continued to record just how little they had in common, she had muttered the words above to herself.^00^00(Keep at it, you two.)^00^00It was the two of them who had saved her and made her want to live for herself. So even though she couldn't fight alongside them as a Reflector, she still wanted to watch over them, support them, and be their strength.^00^00With those secret feelings in her heart, Miyako once again turned her camera toward Hiori and Ruka.

records.jp: ＞MIYAKO：あ、そろそろ１８時だ。私、ちょっと用事があるのよ。^00＞由紀姫：……時間が経つのは早いね～。それじゃあ今日はお開きかな。^00＞MIYAKO：そうね。さっき由紀子が勧めてくれた本は明日買ってみるわね。^00＞由紀姫：お。あの本は絶対みゃーこもハマると思うよ。^00＞MIYAKO：ほんと？　楽しみにしておくわね。それじゃあ、また！^00＞由紀姫：うん。また今度～。^00　ふぅ。と一息ついて、由紀子はノートPCを閉じた。電気を点け忘れた部屋^00の中は、窓から差し込む夕日の色に満たされている。窓の外からは子供たちの^00はしゃぐ声が聞こえてきた。^00　由紀子はパタンとベッドに倒れ込んだ。オレンジ色の天井が視界に広がる。^00　「みゃーこがいなかったら、どうなってたんだろう……」^00　何気なく呟いて、思わず身震いした。^00　あの日、由紀子を救ったのは間違いなくみゃーこ——白樺都だった。^00　「私はあなたが知りたい。由紀姫じゃない、本当のあなたを」^00　その言葉が心の奥に届いたとき、彼女は由紀姫という偽りの自分ではなく、^00高岡由紀子という本物の自分が息を吹き返す。その脈動を感じた気がした。^00　だから今、由紀子がベッドの上から眺める世界は、以前よりも少しだけ、明^00るく鮮やかだった。
records.en_original: > MIYAKO: Ah, it's almost 6. I have some errands I gotta do.^00> Princess Yuki: Time sure flies, huh? Well, I guess that's it for today.^00> MIYAKO: Yeah. I'll make sure to buy that book you recommended tomorrow.^00> Princess Yuki: I just know you'll get totally hooked on it.^00> MIYAKO: Really? I'll look forward to it then. See ya!^00> Princess Yuki: Yeah, later~^00^00Yukiko closed her laptop with a sigh. She had forgotten to turn the lights on, so the room was bathed in the color of the setting sun streaming through the window. She could hear the cheerful voices of children playing outside. She flopped onto her bed, the orange ceiling spread out above her.^00^00"What would've happened to me if Miyako hadn't been there?"^00^00Yukiko murmured that absentmindedly, but a shiver ran down her spine at the thought. There was no doubt Miyako had saved her that day.^00^00"I want to get to know you. Not Princess Yuki, the real you."^00^00When those words echoed in her heart, it felt as if her false self, Princess Yuki, had fallen away and Takaoka Yukiko—the real her—had come back to life. That's why now, the world Yukiko gazed at from her bed seemed just a little brighter—a touch more vivid than before.

records.jp: その年の七夕は雨だった。^00　中学校から帰る途中の美弦の頭上からぽつりぽつりと降り始めた雨は、すぐ^00にシャワーのようになって街を覆った。^00「……なにも今日降らなくてもいいのに」^00　傘を打つ雨音に、美弦は恨めしそうに呟いた。張り切って七夕の準備をする^00陽桜莉の姿が頭をよぎって、彼女は吹き込む雨も気にせずに駆け出した。^00　家で彼女を迎えた陽桜莉の「おかえり」は、どこか元気が無かった。^00「織姫と彦星、会えないのかな……」^00　姉妹二人きりの夜。残念そうに言葉を零した陽桜莉を、美弦は屋上に連れ出^00した。雨を止ませる魔法なんて使えない。だけど、それでも彼女は妹に伝えた^00いことがあった。^00「この雨は、織姫と彦星の、二人の嬉し涙なんじゃないかな」^00「嬉し涙？」^00「そう。だからこの雨は悲しくなんてないのよ。あの雲の上で、二人はきっと^00会える。きっと……」^00　陽桜莉を元気づけようと紡いだ言葉。だが、それは美弦にとっての願いでも^00あった。いつかきっと、母にもう一度会える。そんな願いを胸に抱いて、二人^00は一つ傘の下で肩を寄せ合い、雲の向こうの天の川に想いを馳せる。
records.en_original: It rained on Tanabata that year. Drops of rain began to fall onto Mio's head on her way home from middle school, and quickly turned into a downpour that covered the whole city.^00^00"It didn't have to rain today of all days," she muttered bitterly while the rain drummed against her umbrella. She pictured Hiori eagerly preparing for Tanabata and broke into a run, not caring about the rain blowing onto her.^00^00When Mio got home, Hiori’s "Welcome home" sounded a little less spirited than usual.^00^00"Do you think Orihime and Hikoboshi won't be able to meet?"^00^00The two sisters were alone that night. Seeing Hiori looking so disappointed, Mio took her up to the rooftop. She couldn't use magic to stop the rain, but even so, Mio had something she wanted to tell her sister.^00^00"Maybe this rain is Orihime and Hikoboshi's tears of joy, because they finally got to see each other."^00^00"Tears of joy?"^00^00"Yeah. So this rain isn't sad at all. I'm sure they're together right now above those clouds. I just know it."^00^00She'd said it to cheer up Hiori, but those words were Mio's own wish as well. One day, they would see their mother again. Clutching that hope close to their hearts, the two sisters huddled together beneath a single umbrella, thinking of the Milky Way far beyond the clouds.

records.jp: 「アタシと美弦がバディ……なぁ」^00　すっかり夕闇に包まれた路地を歩きながら、百は空を見上げた。薄らと雲で^00覆われた空の向こうに、満月が浮いている。星は見えない。^00　……今の世界は一度時間がリセットされていて、元の世界だとアタシと美弦^00は原種とやらに負けて死んでる、だって？　あー！　わけがわかんねぇ！　^00　ガシガシと頭を搔きながら、百は足元の小石を蹴とばした。^00「なんで、あいつはあっち側にいんだよ……」^00　美弦と共鳴したとき、彼女の陽桜莉に対する想いを、百は確かに感じた。そ^00れは誤魔化しようのないほど温かかったのだ。^00　正直苛ついている。美弦が話した「リセット前の世界」について、まだ整理^00がついていない。自分が知らない自分の記憶が存在することも気持ち悪い。そ^00して何より、あれだけ陽桜莉を想う美弦が、それでも妹と敵対する道を選んだ^00理由がわからない自分が情けなかった。^00　百は深いため息を吐いた。^00「……でもまぁ、陽桜莉は守るって、言っちまったもんな」^00　もう前の世界を気にするのはやめだ。何があろうとアタシは陽桜莉を守る。^00あいつが美弦にとっての大切だっていうなら、なおさら守り抜いてやる。^00　よし。と百は拳を握りしめた。美弦たちとの決戦は３日後に迫っている。
records.en_original: "Me and Mio as partners, huh?"^00^00Walking through an alley completely swallowed by twilight, Momo looked up at the sky. She could make out the full moon beyond a thin veil of clouds. No stars were visible.^00^00(...So time in this world has already been reset once, and in the previous timeline, Mio and I lost to the Sephira and died? Ugh! None of this makes any sense!)^00^00Scratching her head in frustration, Momo kicked a pebble at her feet.^00^00"Why is she on their side...?"^00^00When she resonated with Mio, Momo had clearly felt her feelings for Hiori. That warmth was unmistakable.^00^00Honestly, Momo was irritated. She still hadn't sorted out her thoughts about this "pre-reset world" Mio had talked about. It was unsettling to know there were her own memories that she didn't know anything about. But more than anything, Momo hated herself for not knowing why Mio, who cared so much for Hiori, still chose to become her enemy.^00^00Momo let out a deep sigh. "Well, either way, I already promised to protect Hiori."^00^00(No more worrying about the past world. No matter what happens, I'll protect her. If she means that much to Mio, then that's all the more reason to do so.)^00^00"All right." She clenched her fist. The final battle with Mio and the others was only three days away.

records.jp: なんて残酷なんだろう。暗闇に浮かび上がる天井を見つめながら、瑠夏は涼^00楓と亜未琉のことを思い出していた。^00「……涼楓のことをお願いしたいんだ。私は彼女を傷つけてしまったから」^00「あたしは亜未琉の想いから逃げ出して、彼女を傷つけた。だから、あたしの^00想いを抜いてほしい」^00　今日の二人の言葉が、残響のように頭の中から消えないでいる。^00　亜未琉が自分に抱く特別な想いに気が付けなかった涼楓。そんな涼楓との関^00係が変わらないように、彼女に対する想いを手放すことを決めた亜未琉。^00　いつまでも二人一緒にいたい。彼女たちの選択はお互いを想ってのものだっ^00たはずなのに、二人の間には悔恨の念に縛られて、どうしようもないほどにす^00れ違っている。^00　物語なら、これはきっと悲劇だ。隣のベッドで寝息を立てる陽桜莉の方を見^00ながら、瑠夏はそう思った。^00　……モモさんや亜未琉さんだけじゃない。これまで奪われてきたみんなの想^00いを元に戻す方法はきっとある。……だから、私は戦う。^00　そんな決意を胸に、瑠夏はゆっくり目を閉じた。^00　夏の夜風がさらさらとカーテンを揺らしていた。^00
records.en_original: How cruel it all is. Staring up at the ceiling in the dark, Ruka found herself remembering Ryoka and Amiru.^00^00"Please, look after Ryoka for me. I've hurt her."^00^00"I ran away from Amiru's feelings and ended up hurting her. So, I want you to take away my feelings"^00^00The words they had spoken today echoed in her mind, refusing to fade away.^00^00Ryoka, who never noticed the special feelings Amiru held for her, and Amiru, who decided to let go of those feelings for Ryoka, all so that nothing would change between them. They just wanted to stay together, always. Their choices must have been made out of care for each other, and yet, regret kept them apart in a way that seemed impossible to overcome.^00^00If this were a story, it would surely be a tragedy. Watching Hiori breathing quietly in the neighboring bed, Ruka couldn't help but think so.^00^00(...Not just Momo and Amiru. There must be a way to restore the feelings that have been stolen from everyone. That's why I have to fight.)^00^00With that resolve in her heart, Ruka slowly closed her eyes. The summer night breeze lightly rustled the curtains.

records.jp: 「寮則第二条第六項……！」^00　冷静で力強い声がしたかと思った瞬間、ガーンッ！　と、詩の頭に衝撃が炸裂した。ぐらりと揺れる視界に、パチパチはじける意識。そこで彼女は見た。　……お花ちゃん……？^00　いつぞや自分がフラグメントを抜き取ろうとした少女——白樺都が立っている。フライパンを片手に、まるでゴ○ブリを叩き潰した時のような不快感に満ちた表情を浮かべて。そして、鈍痛が急速に詩の頭を包み込んでいく。^00　フライパンでぶん殴られるのは、詩にとっては初めての経験だった。だが、^00気持ちいい。都の敵意も相まって、痛み以上の幸福が彼女を満たしていく。^00　これこれ！　これですぅ♡　私に対する嫌悪……いいえ、これはもう憎悪！^00あぁん、ニーナちゃんの攻撃よりもよっぽどステキ……♡^00　恍惚な微笑みを湛えたまま、詩はその場に倒れ込んだ。^00「で、なんでフライパンなんだ？」^00「ぬか床はさすがにまずいかなって……」^00　朦朧とする中、そんな仁菜と都のやり取りが聞こえてくる。^00　……ぬか床！？　ぬか床って、あの……！？　フライパンよりそっちの方が痛くて気持ちよさそう……♡^00　最後まで自分の欲への素直さを貫いたまま、詩は意識を手放した。
records.en_original: "Dorm rules article 2, paragraph 6."^00^00The moment that cool, commanding voice rang out—BANG!—a blow exploded against Uta's head. Her vision wavered, consciousness bursting into sparks at the edges. And then she saw her. Miyako Shirakaba—the girl she'd once tried to take a Fragment from—holding a frying pan in one hand, her face twisted in repulsion like she'd just squashed a cockroach.^00^00A dull pain swiftly engulfed Uta's head. It was the first time she had ever been struck with a frying pan, but it felt good. Fueled by Miyako's hostility, a happiness far greater than the pain began to fill her.^00^00(Yes, yes! This is it! The disgust directed at me... No, this has gone beyond hatred! Ohh, it's so much better than Niina's attacks...)^00^00Uta collapsed to the floor with a blissful smile on her face.^00^00"So, why a frying pan?"^00^00"Well, I figured using the pickling tub would've been a bad idea."^00^00Half-conscious, Uta could hear Niina and Miyako’s conversation.^00^00(...Pickling tub?! As in, that pickling tub?! That would probably hurt more and feel even better than the frying pan.)^00^00Clinging to her desires to the very end, Uta surrendered to unconsciousness.

records.jp: １１５０キロカロリー分の労働ってなんだ。と、風呂の床にブラシをかけな^00がら仁菜は思う。^00　……チッ。食うんじゃなかった。^00　都はかつて仁菜たちが二度もフラグメントを奪おうとした相手だ。そんな彼^00女が、気前よく５つもおにぎりを作った時点で怪しむべきだった。だが、今更^00後悔しても遅い。これでおにぎりが不味かったなら話は別だろうが、悔しいかな、都の作ったツナマヨは絶品だった。気づいた時には完食していた。^00　……これは強いられた労働じゃない。そうだ。アタシなりの礼儀だ。^00　そう思うと少しだけ心が穏やかになった気がして、仁菜は無言のままブラシ^00を動かしつづけた。そんな彼女の真横で、謎に勝ち誇った表情でブラシ掛けす^00る少女が一人。都である。^00「意外に素直じゃない。山田仁菜」^00「……まぁ、美味かったからな……ツナマヨは」^00　気が緩んでいたからか、つい本音が出た。出た瞬間に後悔した。^00「え？　なに？　ツナマヨがなんて？」^00「うぜぇ……」^00　ほらみろ、こうなる。……言うんじゃなかった。^00　深く深くため息を吐きながら、仁菜はフードを目深にかぶり直すのだった。
records.en_original: (What kind of work burns 1,150 calories?) Niina wondered as she scrubbed the bathroom floor with a brush. (...Tch. I shouldn't have eaten them.)^00^00Niina and her group had tried to steal a Fragment from Miyako—twice, even. She should've suspected something the moment Miyako cheerfully made five rice balls for her. But it was too late for regrets now. If they had tasted bad, it might have been a different story, but, frustratingly enough, Miyako's tuna mayo rice balls were absolutely delicious. By the time Niina realized it, she'd eaten every last bite.^00^00(...This isn't forced labor. That's right. This is just my own way of being polite.)^00^00Thinking that, Niina felt her irritation ease just a little, and she kept silently working her brush. Right beside her, another girl scrubbed with a weirdly triumphant look on her face—Miyako.^00^00"You're being more cooperative than I expected, Niina Yamada."^00^00"...Well, the rice balls were good."^00^00Her guard was down, so she let her true feelings slip. The moment she said that, she regretted it.^00^00"Huh? What was that? Something about the rice balls?"^00^00"Leave me alone..."^00^00(See? This is what happens... I shouldn’t have said anything.)^00^00Letting out a deep sigh, Niina pulled her hood back down over her eyes.
